quest.stop_the_gathering.title: Stop the Gathering
quest.stop_the_gathering.description: Annette has seen signs of monsters gathering near the hidden maze. Find the maze and stop them before Moonvillage is threatened again.
quest.stop_the_gathering.accept: Annette's warning has been added to your Moonvillage requests.
quest.stop_the_gathering.complete: The gathering has been stopped. Moonvillage breathes easier tonight.
quest.stop_the_gathering.objective: Enter the hidden maze and defeat 10 Green Slimes.
quest.forest_supplies.title: Forest Supplies
quest.forest_supplies.description: Moonvillage needs sturdy wood for repairs around the old paths.
quest.forest_supplies.complete: The repair supplies have been delivered.
quest.forest_supplies.objective: Bring 50 wood to the Moon Village Requests board.
quest.moonwell_stones.title: Moonwell Stones
quest.moonwell_stones.description: The old moonwell is losing its ring of stones. Annette wants it repaired before the next clear night.
quest.moonwell_stones.complete: The moonwell stones have been set back in place.
quest.moonwell_stones.objective: Bring 75 stone to the Moon Village Requests board.
quest.lantern_resin.title: Lantern Resin
quest.lantern_resin.description: Kira is sealing lanterns for the village paths and needs sticky sap before the evening mist rolls in.
quest.lantern_resin.complete: The lanterns are sealed and ready for nightfall.
quest.lantern_resin.objective: Bring 30 sap to the Moon Village Requests board.
quest.tea_for_the_watch.title: Tea for the Watch
quest.tea_for_the_watch.description: Annette wants warm tea ready for anyone keeping watch near the hidden paths.
quest.tea_for_the_watch.complete: The watch has enough tea to last the night.
quest.tea_for_the_watch.objective: Bring 3 Healing Tea to the Moon Village Requests board.
quest.maze_scout.title: Maze Scout
quest.maze_scout.description: Someone needs to make sure the hidden maze entrance is still quiet.
quest.maze_scout.complete: Your report has calmed Annette's worries.
quest.maze_scout.objective: Visit the hidden maze, then speak with Annette.
quest.crystal_ledger.title: Crystal Ledger
quest.crystal_ledger.description: Venessa is comparing moonlit mineral records and needs a small set of clear samples.
quest.crystal_ledger.complete: Venessa has the samples she needs for her ledger.
quest.crystal_ledger.objective: Bring 5 quartz and 1 amethyst to the Moon Village Requests board.
quest.wild_herb_basket.title: Wild Herb Basket
quest.wild_herb_basket.description: Lorilai wants a simple basket of valley herbs for a moonlit remedy.
quest.wild_herb_basket.objective: Bring 2 wild horseradish, 2 daffodils, 2 leeks, and 2 dandelions.
quest.shadow_residue.title: Shadow Residue
quest.shadow_residue.description: A strange residue has appeared near the maze. Annette wants samples before it fades.
quest.shadow_residue.complete: The residue samples are safely sealed.
quest.shadow_residue.objective: Bring 2 void essence and 2 solar essence to the Moon Village Requests board.
quest.moon_boss_rumor.title: Moon Boss Rumor
quest.moon_boss_rumor.description: Annette has heard something heavy moving in the maze. If the rumor is true, Moonvillage needs proof.
quest.moon_boss_rumor.complete: The maze is quieter, at least for now.
quest.moon_boss_rumor.objective: Enter the hidden maze and defeat 1 Moonvillage_MoonBoss.
special_order.moonlit_patrol.title: Moonlit Patrol
special_order.moonlit_patrol.description: Annette wants the old maze checked before the next moonrise.
special_order.moonlit_patrol.objective: Go to Custom_Maze, then return and talk to Annette.
